caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the right of the viewer. The man has short, curly dark brown hair and prominent sideburns. His skin tone is light with a pinkish hue, particularly on the cheeks. He has brown eyes and his facial expression is neutral. He is wearing a cream-colored shirt with two visible gold buttons, covered by a tan vest and a brown jacket with a large lavender-pink collar. Around his neck is tied a dark blue scarf or cravat. Draped over both shoulders and across his chest is a blue sash that wraps around his left arm and appears folded at his side. There is a faint floral or circular ornament on his left chest, just below the scarf. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or features present.
title: Figurehead
